date_note: The Telegraph article (republished by AOL) of 24 November reports the company's confirmation of an incident in late October; the page gives no earlier exact day for the disclosure.
title: St James's Place confirms a "cybersecurity incident" in late October, Telegraph reports
summary: The Telegraph reports that wealth manager St James's Place confirmed a cybersecurity incident in late October. A spokesman is quoted as saying it was contained and did not impact operations, and that regulators and affected individuals were notified. The article says the group Mimori reportedly claimed responsibility on 21 October, according to Breachsense; the company has not said how many customers were affected.
plain: A UK wealth manager has confirmed a cybersecurity incident from late October. Its spokesman says it was contained and did not affect operations.
exec: The Telegraph reports the firm says the incident was contained and operations were not affected; it has not said how many customers were affected.

validation.note: Two publishers, The Telegraph (read via AOL) and Bloomberg News (via Bloomberg Law), each state that the company confirmed a cyber security incident in late October, contained, with regulators and affected clients notified. The Mimori claim is relayed by the Telegraph only and is unconfirmed.

review.note: title, date, spokesman statement, Mimori/Breachsense claim, no customer count compared with Telegraph via AOL
